description: Stay in this spacious 700 sq ft (65 m²) Lavie Maison apartment, ideally located on the first floor with elevator , in the heart of the Beaubourg district. Perfect for up to 8 guests, it features 3 bedrooms, a bathroom with a whirlpool bathtub and shower, and a fully equipped kitchen. Bright, welcoming, and overlooking a quiet courtyard, it offers all the amenities needed for a comfortable stay. Its central location makes it the perfect base for exploring Paris on foot.The spaceDesigned to combine comfort and convenience, this 65 m² (700 sq ft) apartment provides everything you need for a pleasant stay in the heart of Paris. It features 3 comfortable bedrooms with double beds and 2 modern bathrooms, including a whirlpool bathtub and a shower, making it ideal for families, groups of friends, or business travelers.The bright and welcoming living room includes a sofa bed for two guests and overlooks a peaceful inner courtyard. The fully equipped kitchen allows you to prepare meals with ease. Wi-Fi, bed linen, towels, air conditioning, heating, a washing machine, a dryer, and all essential amenities are provided to ensure a hassle-free stay.Accommodating up to 8 guests, this apartment is the perfect base for exploring the Beaubourg district, enjoying its cafés and shops, and walking to Paris’s most iconic landmarks.Guest accessLocated on the first floor with elevator, you will have access to the entire property and all its facilities. Check-in is self-service via a connect lock, offering you great flexibility and easy access. Located in a secure building in the heart of the Marais, the apartment guarantees comfort and peace of mind throughout your stay. You’ll enjoy a completely private space, designed to make you feel at home from the moment you arrive.Other things to note-
